resources.string: LineageOS goes into a folder on a partition you already have. Your files stay where they are.
Choose a partition with free space.
On NTFS, exFAT and FAT32 only image files can be used.
LineageOS is already in this folder. It will be updated and your data kept.
A single file. Works on any partition.
The system files in a folder you can browse.
Uses the free space of the partition as needed.
Apps, accounts and files stay as they are.
Needs a Linux partition (ext4, F2FS or Btrfs).
Your files on this partition will not be erased.
When the computer starts, a menu lets you choose LineageOS or another system.
Keep the computer on and the USB drive plugged in.
Creating the space for your data
Remove the USB drive and restart the computer.
This partition is protected by BitLocker. Turn BitLocker off in Windows to use it.
This partition is encrypted. Choose another one.
LineageOS cannot be installed on this kind of partition. Choose another one.
This is the LineageOS USB drive. Choose a partition on the computer.
Not enough free space. Free some space or choose another partition.
On NTFS, exFAT and FAT32 only image files can be used.
On FAT32 each file must be smaller than 4 GB. Choose less space for data.
The space for data must be at least 2 GB.
No EFI partition was found. Install on a disk that has one.
Open the installer from the LineageOS USB drive.
The partition is gone. Try again.
The partition could not be opened. If it belongs to Windows, turn off Fast Startup, shut Windows down and try again.
Copying the files failed. Check the disk and try again.
The space for your data could not be created. Try again.
The EFI partition could not be written. Try again.
LineageOS was copied but the boot entry was not created. Pick LineageOS in the computer\'s boot menu.
Writing to the disk failed. Try again.
The installer service did not answer. Try again.
Plug in the USB drive with the new version of LineageOS, then search for it.
Your apps and data are kept.
This USB drive does not have a newer version.
The apps and data of this install will be erased. Other files on the partition stay.
You can restart the computer now.
Restart the computer to use the new version.
If the computer has more than one disk, set it to start from this one.
LineageOS cannot read LVM volumes. Choose another partition.
LineageOS cannot read RAID partitions. Choose another partition.
This disk has no free space before its first partition to start LineageOS. Leave 1 MB free there, or choose another disk.
The startup code could not be written to the disk. Try again.
The startup menu could not be updated. Try again.
There is no LineageOS in this folder.
This is the LineageOS in use. To remove it, start from the USB drive.
No LineageOS USB drive was found. Plug it in and try again.
To start with Secure Boot on, this computer needs the LineageOS key. Prepare it now and confirm it on the next start.
On the next start, press a key, choose Enroll MOK, Continue and Yes, type the password %1$s and choose Reboot.
Install updates and patches for LineageOS.
Already downloaded an update? Choose the file here.
Restart the computer afterwards to finish removing it.
Your apps and data are kept. The update finishes when you restart.
The patch takes effect when you restart.
Restart to finish applying the patch.
Restart to finish removing the patch.
This file is damaged or is not a LineageOS update. Download it again.
This file was not made by this project or was changed. Download it again from the project page.
This computer is missing a file needed to check updates. Update once from a USB drive, then try again.
This update is for another edition (with or without Google services). Download the one for your edition.
This patch is for another version of the system.
There is not enough free space. Free some space on the computer and try again.
The file could not be opened. Choose it again.
Your system is up to date.
Keep the computer on and connected to the internet.
Could not check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again.
The list of updates could not be read. Try again later.
The download did not finish. Check the internet connection and try again.
The downloaded file is damaged. Try again.
